Remark
[The symmetric case] ↗ thm:lax-milgram-theorem 1. ch6:6.2-rem-1\group Weak Solutions

If $B$ is symmetric, \[ B[u,v] = B[v,u] \quad (u,v \in H), \] then $B$ itself is an inner product equivalent to the Hilbert norm, so Riesz representation gives the result directly. Lax--Milgram does not require symmetry.
